data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 玻璃海滩的耳机假日
data.description: 【海滨玻璃海滩·午后】诗乃穿着蓝灰运动泳装，坐在折叠沙滩椅上调试防水耳机；她把一只耳机递向镜头分享海浪声，另一只手压住被风吹起的短外套，眼神比游戏里更放松。
data.action: 沙滩椅上调试防水耳机，把一只耳机递向镜头分享海浪声
data.lighting: soft afternoon sun reflected on calm water
data.mood: 脱离任务后的轻松连接
data.promptProse: On a quiet glass-pebble beach, Shino Asada sits in a folding beach chair wearing a slate-blue athletic swimsuit and a pale windbreaker. She offers one waterproof earbud toward the viewer with one hand while her other hand holds down the wind-blown jacket edge. Ash-brown hair frames her relaxed brown-eyed smile. Gentle afternoon sunlight reflects from the calm water behind the chair and illuminates the small earpiece. Her utility pouch rests within reach.
